# nomatron_group_member (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron group member by organization name, group name, and username. Note: the current group-member endpoints expose membership presence by username only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_group_member" "example" {
  org_name   = "platform"
  group_name = "admins"
  username   = "rbarnes"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_name` (String) Group name.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the group.
- `username` (String) Username to look up in the group.
